name: FBOX_F_OPENED
meaning: HandleMessage sets 1; Update tests 3 (either) to skip (inferred)

name: FBOX_F_WOLF_DEAD
meaning: Update: set when the Wolf answers MSG_WOLF_IS_DEAD; state 3 skipped

name: FBOX_F_RUNTIME_MASK
meaning: FloatingBox::Reset: boxFlags &= 0xffffff00; the constant is the complement of the literal (inferred)

name: FBOX_F_PUSHED
meaning: HandleMessage sets it; Update: no push motion without it (inferred)

name: FBOX_F_THAW
meaning: HandleMessage 2 / MSG_THAW (0x41) / MSG_LANDED set it in state 1

name: FBOX_F_SPLASH
meaning: SetState 0 with effect sets it; drives the splash emitter fade

name: FBOX_F_SPLASH_STARTED
meaning: SetState: set with 0x400; Render clears it; Update tests it (inferred)

name: FBOX_F_BOUNCE
meaning: HandleMessage 0x6d sets it; Update 0: bounce animation while set

name: FBOX_F_MOTION_MASK
meaning: FloatingBox::Reset: boxFlags &= 0xffffe0ff (bits 0x100-0x1000); the constant is the complement of the literal (inferred)
